name: hvac-auth-method-exposure-assessments
instr:
Add a read-only assessment that preserves provider meaning, exposes incomplete coverage, supports offline change detection, and shows credential presence without disclosing credentials.

Use one immutable request to coordinate selected mounts and optional role collection across AppRole, AWS, Azure, GCP, JWT, Kubernetes, Github, and LDAP. Every participating method returns typed `AssessmentEvidence` with stable identity and scope, readable provider source, explicit sensitivity, and provider-specific attributes preserved without flattening their meaning. Across those methods, assessment completely represents readable configuration, role constraints, provider-specific bindings, sensitive-value presence, and independently unreadable scopes, including AppRole Secret IDs; AWS client, IAM, EC2, and inferred bindings; distinct Azure and GCP resource bindings; JWT claim, audience, subject, and policy constraints; Kubernetes cluster, namespace, service-account, audience, and policy constraints; and Github and LDAP organization, team, group, and user mappings under each backend's configuration-read convention. Record every attempted scope independently as successful, failed, or skipped, preserving usable evidence through partial failures without presenting them as safe. Equivalent observations have one canonical representation: evidence, findings, reports, comparisons, and snapshots retain stable identities and ordering fixed by method, mount, scope, subject, rule, and evidence identity
